result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially cut-off restaurant card.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' are truncated, making it unclear to the user that this is scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance (e.g., a subtle gradient or partial card peek) to indicate horizontal scrollability, and ensure the truncated name has an ellipsis or tooltip to show the full name on interaction.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text contains a typo: 'Restarants' is missing a 'u' (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Fix the typo to read 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' for correct spelling and professionalism.
